theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_rh_radial_euler_identity
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N))), C.Stationary → (∀ᵐ z ∂C.measure, Grassmannian.project z.2 z.1 = z.1) → ∀ g : Euclidean N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → ∫ y, ((n : ℝ) * g y + fderiv ℝ g y y) ∂C.weight = 0
